episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from a week off to debut 'Uncircled,' a trial segment where Munch defends himself against chat accusations of murdering Crum via Rock-afire gorilla. Munch wins by timer after defeating a hot dog doppelganger and Matt Liddell, while advancing lore that he paid Crum's six-figure gorilla debt and that Crum is an 'anti-cum' singularity. The broadcast also covers Trump's Space Command move, 33k Epstein pages, Nestle CEO ouster, Saudi Evo acquisition, and a chocolate-enhancing ambient track. Jeb teaches tea bags and used-panty commerce; Chet prescribes boner jams for therapy; roller-rapper Robbie Love reveals a two-day death experience involving rattlesnake venom, a Sybian, and a van doctor. Pepito closes with a spiritual mosquito sermon and a self-raid.
